# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Cold War: Pakistan 1970 national programme.
## Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_PAK_generator (pak_build.py) from the approved design (claude/mdcw_pak_1970_focus_tree_data.json).
## Edit the generator or the design, not this file. Search for 'COLDWAR' to find every Cold War addition.

on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = PAK }
				PAK = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
							has_focus_tree = COLDWAR_PAK_1970_focus
						}
						COLDWAR_PAK_initialize = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_war_relation_added = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { country_exists = PAK PAK = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_initialized } } PAK = { COLDWAR_PAK_deals_check = yes } }
		}
	}
	on_peaceconference_ended = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { country_exists = PAK PAK = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_initialized } } PAK = { COLDWAR_PAK_deals_check = yes COLDWAR_PAK_scars_check = yes } }
		}
	}
	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { original_tag = PAK has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_initialized }
				COLDWAR_PAK_update_party_programmes = yes
				COLDWAR_PAK_deals_check = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
